Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
  
  
**About The Team**
At Anduril, our Battlespace Awareness Command and Control Software team specializes in solving complex, real-world problems through cutting-edge algorithms and intelligent software integrations. Operating in small, innovative teams, we push the boundaries of what's possible to deliver advanced technologies with mission-critical applications. Our commitment doesn't end with academic research or proof-of-concept experiments; we measure our success by the real-world impact of our deployed solutions. Inspired by Arthur C. Clarke's vision — “Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic” — we aim to achieve groundbreaking results in path planning, route optimization, and autonomous mission execution at the command and control layer. We are currently seeking highly talented technologists to join our mission and redefine the future of defense technology.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Contribute hands-on to a small, collaborative team within the Command and Control Software organization, applying your growing expertise in path planning and route optimization.
* Prototype and help deploy state-of-the-art algorithms for global and local path planning, trajectory optimization, and multi-agent coordination within command and control systems.
* Help develop online (real-time) path planning capabilities that replan safely and efficiently as mission conditions, threats, and vehicle states change.
* Design and develop high-performance software for real-time C2 systems deployed on operational platforms in the field — from operator-facing mission planning tools to autonomous tasking and routing services that orchestrate fleets of unmanned systems — with a strong emphasis on asynchronous programming, concurrency, and reliable execution in resource-constrained environments.
* Implement robust planners, search algorithms, and decision-making systems that generate safe, feasible, and optimal routes in dynamic, uncertain, and contested environments.
* Analyze system performance using high-fidelity simulations, modeling tools, and statistical techniques to validate planner behavior across diverse mission scenarios.
* Support customer success by developing and implementing algorithms and software for mission-critical use cases, including collaborative autonomy, asset routing, and obstacle and threat avoidance.
* Integrate path planning technologies into the broader command and control software stack and development lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and optimization.
* Translate technical progress into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders, including colleagues, operators, and end-users.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in algorithm design, software development, and mathematical modeling with programming expertise in C/C++ and/or Rust.
* Strong knowledge of path planning techniques, such as graph-based search (A\*, D\* Lite), sampling-based planners (RRT, RRT\*, PRM), and online/real-time replanning approaches.
* Demonstrated experience in guidance, navigation, and control (GNC); trajectory optimization and trajectory prediction; and/or the development of predictive models for vehicle dynamics and weapon system effectiveness (e.g., 6-DoF simulation, intercept analysis).
* Solid understanding of applied mathematics, including linear algebra, optimization, computational geometry, and graph theory.
* Knowledge of vehicle dynamics, kinematic constraints, and control theory as applied to autonomous ground, air, or maritime platforms tasked through C2 systems, including high-speed aerial vehicles.
* Familiarity with map representations, terrain reasoning, state estimation, and the efficient handling of large-scale geospatial and environmental data within distributed C2 architectures.
* Exposure to machine learning as applied to planning and decision-making, including reinforcement learning, learned heuristics, and behavior prediction.
* Ability to write robust, concurrent code for planning under uncertainty and operation in complex, dynamic, contested environments.
* Demonstrated ability to work across development lifecycles, from prototyping to optimizing production systems.
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience with Rust for high-performance, safety-critical software.
* Exposure to mixed greenfield/brownfield codebases, including extending an existing planning/routing stack in production.

Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
Radar helps businesses prevent payments fraud and abuse while enabling legitimate customers to transact with confidence. We combine machine learning and AI with the intelligence of Stripe’s global network to make sophisticated fraud prevention accessible to businesses of all sizes.
  
  
Our work spans payments fraud detection, protection against abuse beyond the payment, enterprise APIs that bring Radar’s capabilities into businesses’ own systems and payment flows, and the platform that powers it all. We build everything from reliable, low-latency infrastructure to intuitive tools that help users understand threats and control how they respond.
  
  
Fraud evolves constantly, and so do we. We work directly with users to understand emerging attacks, turn advances in ML and AI into effective defenses, and build products that protect and grow their revenue.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
As a software engineer on Radar, you’ll build products and infrastructure that help businesses understand and stop fraud and abuse. Your work will span backend services, enterprise APIs, and user experiences that put sophisticated prevention capabilities into our customers’ hands.
  
  
You’ll own problems from investigation through launch, partnering with product managers, designers, and data scientists. You’ll have opportunities to scale systems that make real-time decisions across Stripe’s global payments network, bring advances in ML and AI into production, and build new products from scratch. Every improvement can have a direct impact on the revenue our users retain and the legitimate customers they serve.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build and operate reliable, low-latency services that detect and prevent fraud and abuse at scale
* Design APIs and dashboard experiences that help businesses investigate threats, configure defenses, and understand how Radar protects them
* Develop the shared platform and infrastructure that enable teams to build and launch new Radar capabilities
* Work directly with users to understand emerging threats and turn those insights into broadly useful products
* Partner with ML engineers and data scientists to bring new signals, models, and AI capabilities into production
* Own projects end to end, from technical design and implementation through rollout, measurement, and iteration
* Uphold a high bar for engineering quality, reliability, and product craft while moving quickly as threats evolve

Who you are
  
  
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 2+ years of industry software engineering experience
* Strong coding skills in any programming language, with experience building and maintaining production software
* Ability to work across systems and technologies, learn unfamiliar codebases, and make thoughtful technical trade-offs
* A rigorous approach to problem solving, including using data to investigate issues and evaluate whether a solution works
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across disciplines and contribute to your peers’ success
* An ownership mindset and comfort navigating ambiguity, taking initiative, and following through on user problems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building distributed systems or real-time services with demanding reliability and latency requirements
* Experience building APIs, developer platforms, or intuitive user interfaces for complex workflows
* Experience bringing ML or AI capabilities into production software
* Experience working on fraud prevention, abuse prevention, risk, or security
* Experience taking a product from an early idea to launch and iterating directly with customers

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
The annual US base salary range for this role is $156,800 - $235,200. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.
